lines.text: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit?
Where can I flee from Your presence?
If I ascend to the heavens, You are there;
if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
If I rise on the wings of the dawn,
if I settle by the farthest sea,
even there Your hand will guide me;
Your right hand will hold me fast.
If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me,
and the light become night around me”—
even the darkness is not dark to You,
but the night shines like the day,
for darkness is as light to You.
For You formed my inmost being;
You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
I praise You,
for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
Marvelous are Your works,
and I know this very well.
My frame was not hidden from You
when I was made in secret,
when I was woven together
in the depths of the earth.
Your eyes saw my unformed body;
all my days were written in Your book
and ordained for me
before one of them came to be.

pictures.scene: Carlo Antonio Tavella, Jonah and the Whale - Jonah put out of the great fish onto the shore under a wide stormy sky with the sea he fled across still behind him, You hem me in behind and before, where can I go to escape Your Spirit, where can I flee from Your presence
pictures.name: pd_tavella_vluchten

pictures.scene: Emmanuel Tzanes, The Ladder of Divine Ascent - the long ladder going up to Christ waiting at the top of it with the climbers on every rung and the darkness below them, if I ascend to the heavens You are there, if I make my bed in Sheol You are there
pictures.name: pd_tzanes_hemel

pictures.scene: Claude Lorrain, A Seaport at Sunrise - the sun coming up over the water of the harbour with the ships lying at anchor and the men already at work on the quay, if I rise on the wings of the dawn or settle by the farthest sea, even there Your hand will guide me and Your right hand will hold me fast
pictures.name: pd_lorrain_dageraad

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, Flight into Egypt - Joseph leading the donkey through the night with Mary and the child while the angel beside them carries the one light that falls on the road, even the darkness is not dark to You, the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You
pictures.name: pd_rubens_duisternis

pictures.scene: Adrianoupolitis Konstantinos, The Birth of the Virgin - the mother lying on her bed with the women come to help her and the newborn child being washed and wrapped at the foot of it, for You formed my inmost being and knit me together in my mother's womb, I am fearfully and wonderfully made
pictures.name: pd_konstantinos_moederschoot

pictures.scene: Max Liebermann, Flachsscheuer in Laren - the long flax barn with the spinners at their wheels and the threads running the whole length of the room, my frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret and woven together in the depths of the earth
pictures.name: pd_liebermann_geweven

pictures.scene: Valentin de Boulogne, Saint Paul Writing His Epistles - the apostle bent over the open book with the pen in his hand setting down what he has been given to write, Your eyes saw my unformed body, all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be
pictures.name: pd_valentin_boek
